{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2 rows)
df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'], inplace=True)

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
grouped = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = grouped.idxmax()

# Print the result
highest_mean_species"}
